event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 45 percent, barometer 30.13 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,067 feet, track temperature 119 degrees.

Vandergriff and Prock have each won 4 times against the other in prior events and this is the first time they
have faced each other in a final round.

Prock with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He wins his second Wally this season
and 23rd in his career.  Prock is now in third place in points.

Vandergriff started dancing around on the top end in the losing effort.
